description: One-line operator action per (fault, NE 107 state). Read by models/guidance.py:guidance(); deterministic, no learning. {cyl} is the decision's cylinder, {sensor} the failed sensor(s).
priority: ALARM > UNCLASSIFIED > sensor FAILURE > ADVISORY > NORMAL: one line, the most urgent

alarm.misfire|OFF_SPEC: Reduce load; inspect coil and plug on cyl {cyl}
alarm.knock|OFF_SPEC: Reduce load; check fuel quality and timing
alarm.injector_clog|MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED: Schedule injector inspection; safe to run

unclassified|OFF_SPEC: Unknown pattern: inspect, do not clear
sensor|FAILURE: Check sensor wiring ({sensor}); engine state unknown
advisory|NORMAL: One witness only ({fault}): keep running, watch for ALARM

capability._note: Lines keyed by what the SOURCE can do, not only by fault/state (models/guidance.py: capability). They replace the generic line for that key.

single_witness_real_obd.advisory|NORMAL: Single witness on real OBD data: ALARM needs a second witness this source doesn't have.
